2. Olympia Fields
The Village of Olympia Fields has 1,221 residents over 16 years of age who are employed. 61.3% of this number are employed in professional or managerial positions, 25.1% are employed in clerical or sales jobs, 5.7% are employed as craftsmen or operatives, 0.4% are laborers or farmers, and 7.6% are employed in service type positions, 72.9% of the working population of Olympia Fields commutes by automibile. The median family income for Olympia Fields is $29,781 per year. 2.6% of the families in Olympia Fields earn less than $7,000 per year, 1.4% of the families earn between $7,000 and $9,999 per year, 7.8% earn between $10,000 and $14,999 and 88.2% of the families earn $15,000 or more per year. The total assessed valuation for the land in Olympia Fields is $21,570,000. The aggregate tax rate per $100 valuation falls within a minimum of 7.628 and a maximum of 8.216. The municipal tax rate per $100 valuation is 0.942, and the corporate tax rate per $100 valuation is 0.542. The municipal tax extension per capita is $58.42.
